exceptions: SQL relational task/session/MCP/alias columns are retained where transactional predicates, uniqueness and audit queries require them. Runtime APIs expose validated state-specific models; no new generic workflow engine or duplicate state column is introduced.

Historical encrypted v1/v2 checkpoints preserve their version and content. Every valid old shape decodes into a state variant. Invalid or contradictory state fails closed and remains evidence rather than being silently deleted.

Independent UI selections, form values, immutable policy/capability flags, caches and timeout resource handles are not all-or-nothing workflow payloads. React, AbortController and provider schedulers own their lifecycle; application ownership/generation fences remain explicit.

The files-service batch callback retains Any only at the pinned external SDK boundary: the stub declares HttpRequest, but the implementation delivers request.postproc JSON. GoogleFile/GoogleFileAccessLocation model_validate immediately validates it; owned worker results use the explicit chunk union.

Legacy environment names remain boundary input fields only. Frozen Settings/DocumentSettings validate them once into the explicit runtime choices; production consumers no longer interpret nullable MCP/queue fields or an enabled flag.

DatabaseSettings remains independently loadable for Alembic and recovery without application auth secrets. Its shared validated connection model is reused by application settings; the database engine consumes the minimal database snapshot.

Native OAuth expiry is one required immutable timestamp compared with the authoritative database clock. Live/expired is derived at each read; a stored expired boolean would create a competing source of truth. Migration 0030 rejects nullable expiry and closed-namespace/digest violations without altering ciphertext or deleting replay receipts.

Native terminal/pagination and readability terminal plans are pure, bounded content proofs within the existing explicit provider checkpoint machines. needs_write is derived from exact observed style. Pagination found/matches aggregates two independent pieces of readback evidence; all four combinations are meaningful, and partial recognition fails closed. They do not encode worker ownership, retry, approval or completion. Immutable builder/version digests retain old mutation reconstruction semantics.

ModelReviewPendingError is a typed resource-unwinding signal for the existing PatchGenerator/TaskGroup/task-deferral contract. It carries no state or permission: the explicit model-planning checkpoint must already be durable before it is raised. It prevents execution from continuing to Google mutation while model review remains pending.
